start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunke lag raha hai ki aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi theek hain?

Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free call kar sakte hain. Mann ki pareshani ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 hai. Kabir, aap theek nahi hain—abhi
